title: No scanning support for email receipts with PDF attachments
text:
I just started to try this application with travel related expenses I wanted to track. I had airline booking emails, hotel folio summary of charges, and a number of printed receipts from dining out. The ability to photograph and import entries was nice that it could also support the photo album of receipt photos I took from the past. I did have to correct a few entries from the scans where tip amount entries written by hand were treated as some tax amount, even though this was already itemized on the receipts I was scanning.

My BIGGEST concern is that I could not create an expense by uploading a pdf, or by forwarding in an email that contains an attachment (typically a PDF) with the actual receipt details that needs to be scanned. Not sure how this will be useful to me since most hotel folios are comprised of room fees, parking fees, and eating/drinks/snacks that are worth tracking with different categories for expense reporting. I am suspecting that this is "too hard" and the app has simply dodged this important part of its use cases.

title: No obvious customer service
text: I have been using this app for a few years to help with taxes. I have been having trouble with the app, “error -10” and my receipts are not uploading (the attachment is in red) and both the software and my iOS is up-to-date. I went online to try to get information and could not find any, so I tried the contact customer service and it forwarded me to a not secure external site. When you click on customer support, it links you to a feedback page and not a standard customer service page. You have to really search the page for what looks like a proper support email address. I found it under “how to write a review in App Store and earn free package”. So in other words, they will freely give you a free subscription if you give good feedback, but not help others who have problems when they pay for a subscription.
